description: Flat metadata schema for individual fluorescent staining reagents used in imaging experiments on cultured cell lines, capturing provenance, composition, and usage details for reproducible interpretation.

reagent_name.descr: Common name of the reagent used in the imaging experiment (e.g., DAPI, Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-rabbit IgG).

reagent_type.descr: Categorical reagent class; examples: fluorescent dye, primary antibody, secondary antibody, nuclear stain, membrane stain, counterstain.

role_in_experiment.descr: Experimental role of the reagent; examples: target label, counterstain, secondary detection reagent, blocking reagent.

target_analyte.descr: Biological target or epitope recognized or labeled by the reagent; use 'NA' if not applicable.

target_species.descr: Species origin of the target antigen or immunogen, when relevant; examples: human, mouse, rabbit, bovine.

host_species.descr: Host species in which the antibody was raised, if applicable; examples: rabbit, mouse, goat, donkey.

conjugated_fluorophore.descr: Fluorescent label or dye attached to the reagent, if applicable; examples: FITC, Alexa Fluor 488, Cy3, Alexa Fluor 647.

manufacturer.descr: Name of the supplier or manufacturer of the reagent.

batch_lot_number.descr: Lot, batch, or manufacturing identifier used for the reagent.

concentration_value.descr: Numeric concentration of the reagent used in the assay; report in the specified concentration unit.

concentration_unit.descr: Unit for concentration_value; examples: ug/mL, nM, mM, dilution factor.

working_dilution.descr: Working dilution used for staining or labeling; examples: 1:200, 1:1000.

stock_concentration_value.descr: Stock concentration of the reagent before dilution, if known; report in the specified stock concentration unit.

stock_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for stock concentration_value; examples: ug/mL, mM.

solvent_or_buffer.descr: Solvent or buffer used to dissolve or dilute the reagent; examples: PBS, HBSS, DMSO, water, antibody diluent.

preparation_date.descr: Date the reagent working solution was prepared, if tracked.

expiration_date.descr: Expiration date of the reagent or prepared working solution, if applicable.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the reagent or working solution.

storage_condition.descr: Storage condition description; examples: protected from light, aliquoted, frozen, refrigerated.

incubation_time_min.descr: Incubation time with the reagent in minutes.

wash_steps_count.descr: Number of wash steps performed after reagent application.

used_for_fixed_cells.descr: Whether the reagent was used on fixed cells.

used_for_live_cells.descr: Whether the reagent was used on live cells.

cell_line_name.descr: Name of the cultured cell line stained in this record; examples: HeLa, HEK293, U2OS.

cell_line_source.descr: Source or supplier of the cell line, if relevant for provenance.

passage_number.descr: Passage number of the cell culture at the time of staining, if recorded.

fixation_method.descr: Fixation method used before staining, if applicable; examples: paraformaldehyde, methanol, acetone.

permeabilization_method.descr: Permeabilization reagent or method used, if applicable; examples: Triton X-100, saponin.

blocking_buffer.descr: Blocking buffer or solution used prior to staining, if applicable.

qc_status.descr: Quality control outcome for the reagent or staining step; examples: pass, caution, fail.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to this reagent record, including deviations from protocol or interpretation caveats.
